newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mitsubishi Motors revises up 96/97 export target.
newsitem.headline: Mitsubishi Motors revises up 96/97 export target.

text.p: Mitsubishi Motors Corp said on Friday that it had revised up its estimate for vehicle exports to 470,000 units in the year to March 31, 1997, from its May forecast of 440,000 units.
Actual exports totalled 490,000 units in 1995/96, it said in a statement. The statement did not give a reason for the revision.

At the same time, the car maker revised down its estimate for domestic sales to 770,000 units in 1996/97 from its May forecast of 880,000. Its actual sales in 1995/96 totalled 824,000 units, the statement said.
Mitsubishi expected domestic output to be 1.24 million units in 1996/97, down from its May forecast of 1.33 million. Actual domestic output reached 1.28 million units in 1995/96, the statement said.
Mitsubishi's overseas production targets for 1996/97 were unchanged from the May forecast of 800,000 units, it said. Its actual overseas production was 671,000 units in 1995/96.

Mitsubishi also cut its planned investment for research and development to 122 billion yen from its previous plan of 124 billion yen for the current business year. Its actual spending was 106 billion yen in 1995/96.
